spacr.crop_store.docstring:
Ragged object crops in per-well Zarr pixel pools, with the ssCell_Crops table (items 983 and 984, alpha). Each crop is its object's bounding box plus a margin, stored at its own size. A well's crops of one object class go into flat pixel pools inside the project's crop store, ``crops.ome.zarr/plate=

/well=`` (item 0aj; older projects have ``crops/plate=

/well=.zarr``, which still reads): ``/pool/`` holds the pixels ``(C, n)``, ``/mask/`` the object's own mask pixels ``(n,)`` and ``/labels//`` EVERY object class's labels cut to the same box ``(n,)`` (uint16 or uint32 by the shard's largest label), one pool array per shard of ``crops_per_shard`` crops, written whole by the one writer. The crop table gives each crop its pool, offset, height and width, so a crop is one contiguous read; its ``object_label`` with ``labels/`` rebuilds the own-object mask exactly. The table is the ``crop_index`` table of the one store of the project, ``/measurements`` (:func:`_write_crop_index` and :func:`_crop_index_writer` write it, :func:`_read_crop_index` and :func:`crop_rows` read it); the root catalog of an older project is still read. This is spaCR's own crop format, not an OME-Zarr image: viewers open the images, not the pools. :func:`export_crops` writes crops out as TIFF, PNG or npy for other tools.

spacr.image_store.verify_store.docstring:
Re-hash every committed field's channel planes against what was recorded (item 0aj).

The channels of ``fov.ome.zarr`` are the acquired pixels, byte for byte;
this is the check every run ends with and that
``keep_original_images=False`` passes before it deletes an original.

:param store: the project's ``fov.ome.zarr`` (or the project folder).
:param originals: optional ``{field file name: [plane, ...]}`` to compare
    the stored planes with as well (value, dtype and shape); a field with
    z planes lists them channel by channel, each channel's planes in z
    order (item 0aj P3).
:param names: check only these field file names (the fields a run
    just wrote); every committed field when None.
:returns: ``{"fields": n, "planes": n, "mismatches": [...], "unrecorded": [...]}``;
    a field written before hashes were recorded is listed as unrecorded.
